assumptions: Foreground, midground, and background details not established by the source scene or shot list remain unspecified.
storyboard_intent: Make Ninel's learned breath, uncertain reflection, and turn toward the revealed planet readable while preserving the reflection's ambiguity.

panels.moment: At countdown seven, Ninel's open eye observes frost move as she begins her first dry inhale.
panels.camera_height: At Ninel's eye line behind the chamber glass.
panels.foreground: Condensation and frost on the chamber glass.
panels.midground: Ninel's eye, slightly below frame center.
panels.subject_placement: Ninel's eye sits slightly below center with the diagnostic reflection crossing the glass.
panels.action_direction: Frost disturbance travels across the glass toward frame right.
panels.movement_state: Her voluntary inhale begins and the camera begins its slow dolly out.
panels.lighting_note: Emergency pulse and cold diagnostic source retain eye and glass detail.
panels.audio_cue: The diagnostic countdown reaches seven with chamber vibration and Ninel's first dry inhale.
panels.continuity_note: Preserve the frost pattern and eye line for the later wider angle.
panels.dramatic_purpose: Present life as a learned action rather than an automatic fact.

panels.moment: Ninel has turned away while the monitor reflection appears to continue looking at her.
panels.camera_height: Slightly below Ninel's seated eye line.
panels.foreground: The chamber edge and Ninel's planted right hand.
panels.midground: Ninel seated and half-turned away from the monitor.
panels.background: The monitor occupies a dark secondary plane at frame right.
panels.subject_placement: Ninel is held in controlled central geometry; the monitor remains background-right.
panels.action_direction: Ninel turns toward frame left while the reflected turn appears delayed.
panels.movement_state: The dolly-out is complete and camera holds; her turn pauses at the test state.
panels.lighting_note: Existing chamber and emergency sources keep the monitor near-black without an anomaly cue.
panels.audio_cue: Chamber release and low hum settle into a restrained quiet hold.
panels.continuity_note: Keep the right hand on the chamber edge and preserve head angle for the monitor insert.
panels.dramatic_purpose: Let the anomaly occur inside one credible spatial relationship.

panels.moment: The black monitor reflection appears to delay immediately before the monitor clears.
panels.midground: The disputed reflection occupies frame center.
panels.background: Real Ninel is present only as edge spill.
panels.subject_placement: The reflection is centered while real Ninel remains at the frame edge.
panels.action_direction: The reflected turn lags toward frame left before the surface clears.
panels.movement_state: Camera is static; the delayed reflection is about to disappear.
panels.lighting_note: The monitor receives only the established room-reflection state.
panels.audio_cue: The ship hum thins slightly with no sting.
panels.continuity_note: Match Ninel's head angle from S01-SH002 and preserve the anomaly's uncertainty.
panels.dramatic_purpose: Offer evidence without confirming whether it is objective.

panels.moment: The planet reaches its mark behind Ninel before Argo says failure.
panels.framing: Medium-close single ending with Ninel and the slit.
panels.foreground: Ninel's near shoulder anchors the old space.
panels.midground: Ninel faces the planet after following the changing light.
panels.background: The blue-green planet appears through the slit behind her shoulder.
panels.subject_placement: Ninel remains the dominant subject with the planet contained behind her.
panels.action_direction: Ninel and camera turn toward frame right as the planet enters behind her.
panels.movement_state: The synchronized slow arc settles after the visible axis reorientation.
panels.lighting_note: Planet light grows only during Argo's pause while emergency light remains subordinate.
panels.audio_cue: Ninel asks; a pause and structural groan precede Argo's answer.
panels.continuity_note: Show the axis reorientation and place the planet before the word failure.
panels.dramatic_purpose: Turn withheld personal history into an external scale of danger.
